title: Gather love at the Guru's feet
summary: Mind and body are gathered by fastening love to the Guru. Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
takeaway: Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
lifeApplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.

source.shortMeaning: Mind and body are gathered by fastening love to the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: When attention starts scattering, touch the forehead and pull one desire back under the Guru's gaze before it multiplies.

evidence.coreClaim: Mind and body are gathered by fastening love to the Guru.
evidence.turn: Let love, company, and conduct gather under the Guru until forgetfulness weakens.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.
